SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

2. Which statement about Mining in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Mining in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Mining in Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Mining in Kenya.
   D. Explain Mining in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Population distribution in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Population distribution in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Kenya.
   C. Say Population distribution in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Population distribution in Kenya as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries.
   B. Say Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Location, Position and Size of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Location, Position and Size of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Location, Position and Size of Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Say Location, Position and Size of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Location, Position and Size of Kenya.

6. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

7. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

8. Which statement about Weather and Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Weather and Climate never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Weather and Climate as rumours only.
   C. Explain Weather and Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate.

9. Which statement about Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi.
   C. Treat Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi as rumours only.
   D. Say Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui as rumours only.
   B. Say The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui.
   D. Explain The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites.
   B. Treat Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites as rumours only.
   C. Explain Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about African Traditional Education is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat African Traditional Education as rumours only.
   B. Say African Traditional Education never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing African Traditional Education.
   D. Explain African Traditional Education with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Development of Transport and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Development of Communication Traditional forms: smoke signals Modern forms phone and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
